exceptionsNone.title: No tracking problem open
exceptionsNone.body: Delays, address problems, failed deliveries and parcels without news show here.

searchNone.title: No shipment found
searchNone.body: Try the order number, a tracking number, the customer's PO, a carton label or a serial.

holds.title: Holds
holds.placeBody: A held shipment cannot be packed, labelled or handed over until the hold is released.
holds.alreadyHeld: A reason already in force is not offered again.
holds.wordsHint: Kept on the shipment; the floor sees only the reason.
holds.releaseSystem: The system placed this hold: once released by hand, it is not placed again for the same cause.
holds.freeAfter: After this the shipment is free to go on.
holds.whyHint: Kept with the release on the shipment.
holds.bannerFinance: It cannot be packed, labelled or handed over. Finance releases a money hold or one the system placed.
holds.bannerWarehouse: It cannot be packed, labelled or handed over until the warehouse releases it.
holds.stepHeld: On hold ({reasons}): release the hold first

held.noManage: Holds need the right to manage holds.
held.notOpen: Only a shipment that has not left can be held.
held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved.
held.financeOnly: Only finance releases a money hold or one the system placed.

form.whyNeeded: Say why it can go now.

refusal.NOT_OPEN: It has left or is cancelled.
refusal.NOT_IN_FORCE: The hold is no longer in force.

bulk.body: Each shipment picked gets the same hold; one already held for that reason is left as it is.
bulk.gone_one: {count} has left or is cancelled and is left out: {numbers}
bulk.gone_other: {count} have left or are cancelled and are left out: {numbers}
bulk.noneOpen: None of the shipments picked is open.

split.title: Split the shipment
split.heldCarried: The holds in force go with the new shipments.
split.ruleBody: Garments promised for different days leave apart; this shipment keeps those of {day}.
split.handBody: How many garments of each line move onto a new draft of the same order. Garments in a carton or with a serial stay.
split.lineFacts: {quantity} on it · {packed} in cartons · {serials} with a serial
split.carrierHint: As the shipping settings name it (for example brt, gls).
split.shipToNote: Another delivery address: plan a new shipment from the order.

held.noManage: Splitting needs the right to manage shipments.
held.notDraft: Only a draft can be split: unpack it first.
held.busy: Wait: the split is being made.

refusal.NOT_DRAFT: Only a draft can be split.
refusal.NOTHING_TO_MOVE: Nothing can move: every garment is in a carton or has a serial.
refusal.NOTHING_STAYS: Something must stay on this shipment.
refusal.ONE_DAY: Every garment is promised for the same day: nothing to split by date.

cartons.title: Cartons

none.title: No cartons yet
none.body: Packing happens at the pack station (each garment scanned into its carton) or here.

cartons.foot: The pack station fills the cartons live; the office may add or correct.

held.noPack: Cartons need the right to pack.
held.notDraft: Only while the shipment is a draft: unpack it first.
held.labelled: The carton has its carrier label: void the labels first.
held.notEmpty: Take the garments out first (at the pack station).
held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved.

drawer.marksHint: Print the marks again from the pack station or the label prints on Carrier & label.

arrangementLong.CARRIER: A carrier, labels bought through the aggregator

transport.title: How it travels
transport.labelsTest: {count} of them, {test} TEST labels (nothing was bought)

explain.CARRIER: Labels are bought for each parcel through the connected aggregator; the carrier's tracking follows by itself.
explain.MANUAL_CARRIER: Booked by phone or on the carrier's site: no label is bought here; type its tracking number and the statuses it reaches.
explain.OWN_VAN: Our van takes it: no label, no carrier; the DDT names us as carrier; type the statuses as the driver reports them.
explain.CUSTOMER_COLLECTS: The customer collects at our site (ex works): no label and no carrier; the DDT is signed when they collect.

transport.arrange: Our van or a carrier by hand…
transport.typedAfterLeft: Statuses are typed once the goods have left.
transport.ownVanHint: No carrier, no label: the DDT names us.
transport.manualHint: A carrier booked outside: its name and, when known, its tracking number.
transport.trackingHint: Optional; it can be typed later.
transport.arrangeNote: Held once a label is bought or the DDT is issued (it names the carrier).
transport.trackingClearHint: Leave it empty to clear it.
transport.whenHint: Empty: now. Not before the goods left.

done.ownVan: Our own van takes it now.
done.manual: The carrier booked by hand is saved.

held.noManage: This needs the right to manage shipments.
held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved.

form.trackingTooLong: One line of at most {max} characters.
form.when: The time is not a time.
form.future: The time is in the future.
form.beforeLeft: The time is before the goods left.

refusal.LABELLED: A carrier label is bought: void the labels first.
refusal.DECLARED: The DDT is issued and names the carrier: annul it first.
refusal.NOT_A_CARRIER: Only a carrier shipment takes a typed tracking number.
refusal.NOT_LEFT: The goods have not left yet.
refusal.CARRIER_TRACKED: The carrier's own tracking follows it: nothing to type.
refusal.CUSTOMER_COLLECTS: The customer collects: no status to type.

check.title: Check before printing
check.testMode: Test mode: labels say TEST and nothing is sent to a carrier.

notApplying.OWN_VAN: Our own van takes it: no carrier label.
notApplying.CUSTOMER_COLLECTS: The customer collects: no carrier label.
notApplying.MANUAL_CARRIER: A carrier booked by hand: no label is bought here.

check.noParcels: No parcel yet: the check runs once the goods are packed.
check.limitsKept: The weight and size limits kept for {carrier} are starting values, not verified with the carrier.
check.noLimits: No weight or size limit is kept for {carrier}: its own refusal stays the carrier's.

sender.name: The sender's address (the site's shipping settings) lacks who it is.
sender.line1: The sender's address (the site's shipping settings) lacks the street.
sender.postalCode: The sender's address (the site's shipping settings) lacks the postal code.
sender.city: The sender's address (the site's shipping settings) lacks the city.
sender.country: The sender's address (the site's shipping settings) lacks the country.

recipient.name: The delivery address lacks who it is.
recipient.line1: The delivery address lacks the street.
recipient.postalCode: The delivery address lacks the postal code.
recipient.city: The delivery address lacks the city.
recipient.country: The delivery address lacks the country.

check.POSTAL_CODE: The delivery postal code "{value}" is not a postal code of {country} (like {example}).
check.POSTAL_CODE_sender: The sender's postal code "{value}" is not a postal code of {country} (like {example}).
check.PHONE_NEEDED: {carrier} needs the recipient's phone: add it to the delivery address.
check.PHONE_NEEDED_eu: A parcel leaving the European Union needs the recipient's phone (for customs): add it to the delivery address.
check.PHONE_FORMAT: The recipient's phone "{value}" is not a phone number (digits, with + and spaces).
check.NO_SERVICE: Choose the carrier service for the shipment (or a default one in the site settings).
check.NO_WEIGHT: Parcel {seq} has no weight: weigh it first.
check.SIZES_PARTIAL: Parcel {seq} has only some of its sizes: give length, width and height, or none.
check.TOO_HEAVY: Parcel {seq} weighs {weight} kg; {carrier} takes at most {max} kg a parcel: repack it into lighter parcels.
check.TOO_LONG: Parcel {seq} is {length} cm on its longest side; {carrier} takes at most {max} cm.
check.TOO_BIG: Parcel {seq} measures {sum} cm in length plus girth; {carrier} takes at most {max} cm.
check.DOES_NOT_FIT: Parcel {seq} ({sizes} cm) does not fit {carrier}'s largest parcel ({box} cm).

reprint.title: Label prints

none.title: No label printed yet
none.body: Carrier labels and carton marks show here once printed.

reprint.note: A reprint prints the same label again on a label printer of the site: nothing is bought or laid out again; the reason is kept on the shipment.
reprint.reasonHint: One line, kept on the shipment (for example: the label was torn).
reprint.nothingBought: Nothing is bought again: the same label goes to the printer.
reprint.doneTest: TEST labels stay TEST: not for shipping.

held.noRight: A reprint needs the rights to pack and to print labels.
held.notReprintable: One of the labels picked cannot be printed again.
held.notNow: It cannot be printed again now.
held.busy: Wait: the reprint is being queued.

form.reasonShort: Say why in at least {min} characters.

refusal.GOODS_GONE: The goods were delivered, returned or cancelled.
refusal.LABEL_VOIDED: The label was voided or replaced since.
refusal.MARKS_CHANGED: The carton was renumbered since: print its marks anew at the pack station.
refusal.REASON: The reason must be 3 to 200 characters on one line.
refusal.PRINTER: No label printer takes it: set the site's label printer in the shipping settings.

pack.title: Driver's pack (one PDF)

missing.LABELS: A parcel has no label yet (or a label only on the label printer).
missing.PACKING_LIST: No packing list matches the cartons yet: making the pack makes it.
missing.DDT: The DDT is not issued yet, or its file is missing.

none.LABELS: No carrier label: our van, the customer collects or a carrier booked by hand.

pack.notShown: It carries prices: it joins the pack only for someone who sees prices.
pack.latestOld: Newest: version {version}, {when}, {pages} pages — the papers changed since: make it again.
pack.note: Never sent to the customer: the pack is for the driver and the dock.

done.printed: Version {version} made ({pages} pages) and sent to the printer.
done.same: Version {version} already holds these papers: nothing new was made.

notPrinted.NO_PRINTER: Version {version} made; not printed: the site has no document printer. Open the PDF to print it.
notPrinted.PRINTER: Version {version} made; the printer did not take it. Open the PDF to print it.

held.noPack: The pack needs the right to pack.
held.noPrint: Printing documents needs the right to print documents.
held.noPrinter: The site has no document printer: make the PDF and print it from the browser.
held.busy: Wait: the pack is being made.

proforma.title: Proforma invoice

purpose.CUSTOMS: For customs: the goods and their values. Not an invoice.
purpose.SAMPLES: For samples sent out: customs only.
purpose.PREPAYMENT: A request for payment in advance.

problem.noLines: The shipment has no garments yet.
problem.noPrice: A line has no price on its order.
problem.vat: The order's VAT cannot be printed on a proforma.
problem.other: Something on the order or the shipment is not complete.

proforma.note: Its number is taken once; a new version keeps it. The PDF carries prices.
proforma.dialogBody: The goods, values and references are read from the order and the shipment as they are now.

done.same: Proforma {number} version {version} already says this: nothing new was made.

held.noRight: A proforma needs the right to issue proformas and to see prices.
held.busy: Wait: the proforma is being made.
held.noFiles: Opening a file needs the right to read files.

publicDoc.body: The address the QR code on the label holds: the Declaration of Conformity and the user information of each style.
publicDoc.none: No style on this shipment yet.
publicDoc.notLive: Shows no declaration yet: publish it in Compliance › Declarations & instructions.

pod.notDeliveredHint: The proof is kept once the goods are delivered.
pod.carrierAsked: The carrier was asked for its proof: it shows here when it answers.
pod.keptNote: Every part is kept: the proof never changes.
pod.onceNote: Each part is kept once and then never changes.
pod.signerHint: The customer's person who signed, as written on the proof.
pod.imageHint: A photo (JPEG, PNG) or a scan (PDF), at most 15 MB.
pod.done: The proof of delivery is kept.

held.noManage: Recording the proof needs the right to manage shipments.
held.kept: Every part is kept: it never changes.
held.busy: Wait: the last change is still being saved.
held.noFiles: Downloading needs the right to read files.

form.when: The time is not a time.
form.future: The time is in the future.
form.beforeLeft: The time is before the goods left.
form.noUpload: Adding a file needs the right to upload files.
form.type: A photo (JPEG, PNG) or a PDF only.

refusal.KEPT: That part is kept already: it never changes.

problems.title: Tracking problems
problems.none: No problem raised. A parcel without carrier news for {days} days raises one by itself.

what.DELAYED: Tell the customer if the promise moves.
what.ADDRESS_PROBLEM: Check the address with the customer and the carrier.
what.FAILED_DELIVERY: Agree a new delivery with the carrier.
what.NO_SCAN: Ask the carrier where the parcel is.

problems.taskDone: Its task is marked done by you.

notice.title: Customer notice

auto.on: The shipping mail goes by itself to the customer's orders contacts, in their language, when the goods leave.
auto.off: The site's customer notice is off (Shipping settings): nothing goes by itself; Send again mails it by hand.
auto.sent: The notice of this shipment was sent.

why.SWITCH_OFF: The site's customer notice is off: nothing goes by itself.
why.NOT_LEFT: The goods have not left yet: the notice goes when they leave with their tracking numbers.
why.CANCELLED: The shipment is cancelled: no notice goes.
why.TEST_LABELS: It left with TEST labels (test mode): no customer ever gets a TEST tracking number.
why.NO_TRACKING: No carrier tracking number (our van, or the customer collects): nothing to follow.
why.NO_RECIPIENT: The customer has no active orders contact with an e-mail address: add one on the customer first.
why.SENT: The notice of this shipment was sent already.

notice.sendBody: Each contact gets the mail in their language, with the tracking numbers and what is in the parcels (no prices).
notice.fake: On this system the mail goes to the test mailbox: nothing reaches a real customer.

outcome.failed: {sent} sent, {failed} not sent: try again later.
outcome.skipped: Not sent to addresses that refuse our mail: {addresses}

held.noManage: Sending needs the right to manage shipments.
held.busy: Wait: the mail is being sent.
